params.message:
The headers hand writes for Netlify too

Three of the eight sites with a headers task are Astro sites on Netlify,
and the hand refused all three with "this is not a Laravel project". The
refusal was honest and the work was still not done: the same four headers,
a site that cannot say them in PHP.

So the site says how it sends a header and the hand writes for that. A
Laravel app: a middleware, a provider, one line in bootstrap/providers.php.
A Netlify site: public/_headers, which Netlify serves from the published
directory and every static builder copies verbatim. Same safe set, same
certificate, same judge, same ledger; another writer. Still never an
overwrite: a project that already carries _headers decided something this
hand cannot read.
